selection: the same six fixed engineering cases and all their 21 diagnostic candidates; never substitute failed material
teacher_edit_rule: identical v4 conceptual explanation prompt without attention evidence for every position; no sampled student outcomes used to generate or select explanations
comparison: same question and exact teacher prefix before the candidate, explanation versus no explanation; repeat seeds matched across the pair; no current/future reference step in student prompt
primary_score: unchanged numeric final answer parser v1; frozen v2 sensitivity also reported
scope_limit: two continuations per condition/position are an engineering smoke test, not an independent selector efficacy evaluation or power calculation
